reserveReview.reviewer: SOL-III V9 reserve-slice review; Kimi T27 V9 reserve-slice refresh; Kimi R05 live-adapter replay

sources.label: Resupply Registry and pair accounting on Ethereum

reserveReview.rationale: The independent resupply-pairs producer enumerated every configured positive-collateral pair and converted its ERC-4626 shares at the same on-chain capture. A 2026-08-08 replay of all eleven configured pairs at the latest Ethereum block (underlying(), getPairAccounting(), collateral(), convertToAssets()) returned $24,371,493 crvUSD-side and $1,713,015 frxUSD-side converted assets, i.e. 93.4% Curve crvUSD lending-market exposure and 6.6% Fraxlend frxUSD lending-market exposure. Both are layered protocol positions whose upstream issuer and smart-contract failure domains remain explicit.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact live Resupply pair registry and ERC-4626 collateral conversion captured on 2026-08-08 via the configured resupply-pairs adapter against public Ethereum RPC
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No positive-collateral pair is omitted; vault liquidity, borrower collateral, and upstream crvUSD or frxUSD solvency remain structured risk factors within the two classified positions.
